cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The inspector initialled the complaints, so I have too. As my deputy, you can deal with the approved replies.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His initials mean received, not approved. These are complaints about your decisions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, received. You handle the replies below decision-making level. Sign them as deputy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whoever signs has to attend tomorrow's hearing. I don't want to defend your decisions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Attend as my representative, then. You can take their questions and bring them back for me to decide.

reason: Copy inspector initials without understanding, then redirect discovered responsibility downward; hearing triggers subordinate messenger role.
